A polish release from a full audit of every core page at desktop, tablet and phone widths: no more cut-off checkboxes, buttons or dropdowns, and lighter live graphs.

### Grids (Users, Groups, Rules, NAT and every other table)

- **Select-all checkbox fully visible**. The checkbox in the header of the selection column was clipped on its right side; it is now centred in the column, as are the row checkboxes.
- **Row command buttons fit**. Edit / copy / delete buttons in narrow command columns (Monit, Cron and others) were cut off. The cell padding is tighter and the buttons slightly more compact, so all of them show.
- **Footer buttons on phones**. On empty tables at phone width the Add / Export buttons in the footer were cut off at the bottom, because the footer wraps onto several lines. An empty table now grows to fit its footer.
- **Search box corners**. The right end of the grid search box is rounded again (a hidden *clear* button squared it off).

### Toolbar dropdowns

- Dropdowns in grid toolbars (Firewall Rules interface and categories, Aliases type and categories, NAT and others) now size to their value, so long choices are no longer cut short.
- The two dropdowns on Aliases have a gap between them.
- The refresh / page size / columns / export / full-screen buttons stay on one line on desktop; the search box takes the remaining space.

### Smoother, lighter live graphs

- The dashboard CPU graph draws at 30 fps and the Traffic Graph at 20 fps instead of as fast as the browser allows. They look the same, with much less CPU used on the firewall's browser tab: long frames while scrolling the dashboard fell from about 12% to about 5%.

### Under the hood

- The layout audit now finds controls that are partly hidden by their container (`cut-control`) and records browser console errors, and the interaction tests check that grid checkboxes and command buttons are fully visible on all three supported OPNsense versions.
